name: Whisper
description: Transcribe speech locally with whisper.cpp. The presets used to call a binary named 'whisper' (OpenAI's Python CLI) which this project does not install — they now go through whisper_run, which finds the whisper.cpp build and the largest real model.

presets.label: Transcribe English
presets.description: Force English transcription with base model

presets.label: Transcribe in a language you choose
presets.description: Force one language: give its two-letter code in the extra arguments (for example fr, de, ar, ja). Leave it empty for auto-detect.

presets.label: Generate subtitles (.srt)
presets.description: Auto-detect language, output timestamped SRT subtitle file

presets.label: Transcribe (large model, more accurate)
presets.description: Uses the largest model installed (the wrapper picks it automatically)

install_note: Installed by the Cockpit installer (media phase) into the shared venv ~/scripts/cockpit_data/venv. Re-run Installs/install_cockpit.sh and choose the media/transcription phase, or set the binary override in Tools settings to the venv's whisper.
